About

Finding frames others walk past

I'm Paras — 18, based in Gurugram. I picked up a camera five years ago and haven't really put it down since. My work spans long-exposure urban landscapes, wildlife, event photography, and motion experiments that look like accidents but aren't.

Beyond photography, I edit video — cutting footage, grading colour, building the rhythm that turns raw clips into something worth watching. Stills and film aren't separate disciplines to me; they're both about slowing down enough to notice what's actually there.
